productConcept.name: Varo Studio
productConcept.description: Bespoke door handles, hinges, and escutcheons cast and finished by hand in a Copenhagen workshop — made to order for architects, developers, and interiors that demand the real thing.
productConcept.rationale: The Weld & Straw design system's warm dark surface palette (#1a1a18, #2d2b27), editorial Inter 700 headings, and restrained spacing scale called for an object-making workshop with material gravity. Architectural hardware avoids the cliché luxury brand direction while matching the precision craft vocabulary, the warm metallic warmth of unlacquered brass against dark carbon tones, and the tactile register of the motion system's 0.75s–1.5s deliberate transitions. The name Varo — from Latin 'varus' (bent, angled) — suggests the geometry of a hinge or handle without being obvious.
